''See also: [[Subject One Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Subject One is a [[Dreadgod]] and the progenitor of their bloodline, often described as the original being from which all others were formed. Though some believe the [[Dreadgods]] only gained intelligence following its death, it was known to be an intelligent and clever entity. It is closely associated with [[hunger madra]], serving as either its source or its very first host. Subject One was once a man who became distorted by [[hunger aura]], and it is also identified as the fifth [[Dreadgod]]. For a long period, Subject One was held captive within a [[labyrinth]] that served as its prison. This location was controlled by the entity, and its will permeated the structure. [[western labyrinth|The labyrinth]] contained various [[binding|bindings]] made of dense [[hunger madra]], including a [[core binding]] that was highly unique and valuable. While Subject One's power was eventually distributed among the other [[Dreadgods]], its [[core binding]] remains a significant material that can be used to create items like the [[Wraith Horn]]. The entity's influence and techniques, such as its arm, can still be accessed or unleashed by others.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Subject One is the father of the [[Dreadgods]]. [[Lindon]] and his group are investigating to find him, and [[Lindon]] possesses a hand of Subject One in a silver case.}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Subject One is the first product of experiments that created the [[Dreadgods]], often referred to as the [[Slumbering Wraith]] or the Father of Hunger.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c2">''Reaper'', chapter 2</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c22">''Reaper'', chapter 22</ref> Born from a birth [[pod]] or [[tank]] within [[labyrinth|the labyrinth]], this six-armed man is a prisoner who does not remember his name.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c19">''Reaper'', chapter 19</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c20">''Reaper'', chapter 20</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c22" /> The entity possesses a gaping hole in his chest where his heart should be and uses [[hunger madra]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c20" /><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c22" /> While Subject One waits in a deep chamber at the center of [[labyrinth|the labyrinth]], his mummified left hand of chalk-white flesh acts as the pulsing heart of the structure and is contained within a small metal cube.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c2" /><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c3">''Reaper'', chapter 3</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c10">''Reaper'', chapter 10</ref> Although Subject One controls [[labyrinth|the labyrinth]] and has seen his attacks intensify, he is currently unable to reach [[Lindon]]'s group.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c8">''Reaper'', chapter 8</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c10" /><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c12">''Reaper'', chapter 12</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Subject One implanted a dense knot of [[hunger]] within the walls of [[labyrinth|the labyrinth]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c2">''Dreadgod'', chapter 2</ref> This entity, which is associated with [[Lindon's white arm|Lindon's white hand]], was once a prisoner in [[labyrinth|the labyrinth]] but is now dead.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c3">''Dreadgod'', chapter 3</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c4">''Dreadgod'', chapter 4</ref> Possessing a [[core binding]], Subject One was restricted to [[labyrinth|the labyrinth]]'s lower half.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c4" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c6">''Dreadgod'', chapter 6</ref> After being encountered in [[labyrinth|the labyrinth]], Subject One's arm was used by [[Lindon]] to help crush the [[Dreadgod]]'s will.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c11">''Dreadgod'', chapter 11</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c16">''Dreadgod'', chapter 16</ref> [[Lindon]] eventually unleashed the arm of Subject One, an entity capable of eating a call for help.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c18">''Dreadgod'', chapter 18</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Waybound}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Subject One possesses a [[core binding]] composed of a unique and irreplaceable material.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c4">''Waybound'', chapter 4</ref> During an encounter, [[Lindon]] is forced to wrestle one of Subject One's arms into submission.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c6">''Waybound'', chapter 6</ref> Pieces of the entity's body are used to feed [[labyrinth|the labyrinth]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c14">''Waybound'', chapter 14</ref> The eventual death of Subject One serves as a significant point of belief concerning the moment [[Dreadgods]] acquired intelligence.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c24">''Waybound'', chapter 24</ref> Additionally, the [[binding]] of Subject One was fashioned into a horn.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c25">''Waybound'', chapter 25</ref>}}
